title: Product noise kernel
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with at least two elements, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $\rho$ satisfy $-1/(|\Omega|-1)\le\rho\le1$. For each $x\in\Omega^n$, define a probability distribution on $\Omega^n$ by independently choosing each output coordinate according to the coordinate noise distribution with parameter $\rho$ centered at the corresponding coordinate of $x$.
